scope: Complete recorded empty normal-10pt HTMLDocumentField widgets: default/two explicit sizes, ReadOnly, Enabled, BorderColor, title hidden and native-ignored BackColor/ShowToolbar requests. Ten native sources, seventeen complete-widget samples per locale. Full forms and other property/state/display matrices remain open.

nativeInputs.scope: Ten measured empty normal-10pt HTMLDocumentField inputs on native ru/en; recorded complete widget cases are calibrated, other properties/profiles and full forms remain open.

surface.backColor: Removed by native field export; the empty design-time document body stays white.
surface.showToolbar: Removed by native field export; true and false requests leave the same empty surface.

nativeMetricsChangedAfterFreeze: Explanatory scope/acceptance metadata only; all XML, rows, dimensions and RGB hashes are unchanged.

implementation.sharedDimensions: HTMLDocumentField is the fifth independently measured consumer of documentSurfaceMetrics: 500x243 default, 200x118 for Width20/Height5, 350x218 for Width35/Height9.
implementation.body: The complete empty native body is white, including ReadOnly/Enabled and BackColor=web:Black. BackColor is removed by canonical native field export and does not change this static surface.
implementation.outerBorder: Normal/ReadOnly retain active BorderColor; Enabled=false uses #e8e8e8. Blue BorderColor is accepted.
implementation.toolbar: ShowToolbar true/false is removed by native field export and leaves the same empty widget. Both requested XML and canonical exports are retained. The viewer keeps an inert empty surface without loading HTML content or invoking an embedded browser engine.
implementation.applicabilityLimit: Other html-document field properties, runtime document formatting, the full typed-property inventory and computed-property inspector semantics in T152/T155 remain open.

nativeOperations.closeNote: The initial capture/close shell ended with signal 15 and the HTML session remained open. The sandbox /proc namespace could not establish host-process absence. Later host-side inspection found the owned session; a separate owned-PID/XID guarded stop returned 0 and host process/window inventory confirmed closure. Native captures and all pixel/session comparisons were independently scoped to their targets; their results are unchanged.

remaining: Other fonts/dimensional limits/fractions/stretching, combined color/state properties, other html field properties and nonempty static document content where supplied by XML.
